author: forddyce92
quote:
Graphics is good, and there's a lot variety on it.  For a game graphics that is this good, seeing it at 30 fps just doesn't bring the full potential of it.

The relationship mechanic is such a turn off for me, it doesn't really feel like GTA and feels very out of place. The fact they placed this mechanic in play to integral parts of the game, including getting all the ending, and said that this is entirely optional, is just a straight up lie.

Even after the ending, i found out that I don't care at all about their relationship story. The NPCs and the world are far more interesting, especially the tv ads, and the police cat and the waterboat dog. The low review score from me is for the lazy writing and very low quality of it.

author: forddyce92
quote:
Games like these are suppose to be fun, exciting, interesting character story with their world's lore, great storytelling, fantasy adventures to the unknown.

This is just pushing political agenda, the dialogues don't make me feel anything about the world, every few moments it is about gender, equal rights, it's just pushing real world propaganda into a game. Gamer play games to escape real world, not to be brainwashed by nonsense.
